name: Enchantment Mods
description: Ten new enchantments. Weapons: Frost, Poison and Wither Aspect and Weakening Touch, Strength Surge (more damage below half health), Zapping (chain lightning between nearby mobs, swords) and Life Steal (heal on kills). Armor: Protection Surge (less damage below half health) and Knockback Protection. And the Breaking curse, which wears items out faster. Find the books in trial and ominous vaults, trial chambers, strongholds, mansions, temples, outposts, ancient cities and ocean ruins, buy them from librarians, roll them at the enchanting table, or find them on mob gear and vault and End city loot. Hold a book and tap an anvil to apply it.

name: Armor & Effects HUD
description: Shows your armor and off-hand item with real item icons (glinting when enchanted) and current durability, plus every potion effect with its icon and time remaining, on the left side of the screen. When you hit a player or mob, the damage it actually took (after armor and effects) floats up above it.
